ai.title: SoftBank’s Masayoshi Son Warns on AI Safety
ai.description: Speaking at a tech forum, SoftBank chief Masayoshi Son - one of AI’s fervent believers - said that even he is worried about safety risks as machines quickly gain more abilities. He reiterated his projection that AI and machines with learning capabilities could account for at least 20% of global gross domestic product by 2040. (Source: Bloomberg)

business.title: John Ternus and Tim Cook took opposite approaches to design, and both were right
business.description: One of the most famous and successful partnerships in the history of technology has been that of Steve Jobs and Jony Ive. When Tim Cook took over as CEO, he did not play the same role in working with Ive on hardware design – and that was the right decision. John Ternus is apparently taking a much more Steve-like approach to working with Apple’s design lab, and I think that too is the right call … more…

devices.title: Full Disk Access on Mac: Here’s what Apple must, and must not, do
devices.description: We’ve seen a number of examples of why giving Meta’s Muse app full disk access to your Mac is a very bad idea, and yet another major privacy issue has recently been discovered. It’s now been found that Muse analyzes your communication with everyone in your life on an hourly basis. Apple is rightly concerned about the development, and in a blog post says that it will be introducing additional controls around the Full Disk Access feature that’s been enabling the problems … more…

devices.description: Getting some extra storage space on your Mac could be as easy as deleting Apple's AI features with a new open-source command line tool called RemoveMacAI. There used to be a single Settings toggle for disabling Apple Intelligence, but that was removed in macOS 27. Now, the models stay on your disk, and the features are split up across different settings panes. devices.title: Mac Users Reclaim 12GB+ of Storage With Apple Intelligence Removal Tool
devices.description: A new open-source tool is making waves in the Mac community by helping users reclaim valuable storage space taken up by Apple's AI models. Called "RemoveMacAI," the command line tool disables Apple Intelligence on macOS 27, removes its downloaded models, and prevents them from being downloaded again. devices.title: New Apple TV 4K launches next week with two major upgrades
devices.description: New Apple products are reportedly launching on October 13, including an updated Apple TV 4K. Here are the two major upgrades rumored for the new Apple TV. more…

devices.title: Fantastical’s long-awaited Android debut begins today on Googlebook
devices.description: Fantastical has long been hailed as one of the greatest calendar apps available today, but if you’re an Android user, there’s a good chance you’ve never used it. Despite a move from Apple exclusivity to cross-platform availability on Windows, Android has long eluded the attention of development team Flexibits. Today, that’s finally changing, as Fantastical is headed to Google’s mobile OS platform — but not precisely in the way you might expect. more…

devices.title: Apple Releases MagSafe 3 Charging Cable Firmware Update
devices.description: For the first time since February 2023, Apple has released a firmware update for the MagSafe 3 charging cable for the MacBook Pro and MacBook Air. Specifically, Apple last week released firmware version 3.2.0 for the USB-C to MagSafe 3 Cable. The previous firmware version for the cable was 3.1.12. It is unclear what is included in the latest firmware, as Apple does not publish release notes for this. devices.title: Apple TV doc All of Us shows how iPads enable inclusive learning in a unique school
devices.description: A new documentary available on Apple TV, All of Us, tells the story of a public elementary school that has taken a unique approach to how education works for students with very different needs. Both iPhones and iPads play a key role in enabling what has been described as a powerful example of how inclusive education can work for every child … more…

devices.title: Focus Modes are another way Apple has adapted iOS 27 for the iPhone Duo
devices.description: The unique form factor of the iPhone Duo led Apple to adapt iOS 27 in a number of ways to take full advantage of the upcoming new phone. This includes the iPhone dock sitting on the right-hand side of the outer display instead of at the bottom of the screen. Developer pdfu has now spotted another iPhone Duo-specific feature offering a more convenient way to toggle Focus modes … more…
